mentions.name: PagedPDF
mentions.description: This API converts HTML to PDF and fixes common PDF generation issues: headers no longer get cut off, footers render with legible page numbers, table rows are kept from splitting across pages, and it warns when a font or image fails to load. A demo on the homepage can be tried without signing up.
mentions.problem: Many HTML-to-PDF solutions cut off headers, render footer page numbers illegibly small (e.g. 0.7pt with Puppeteer), split table rows between pages, and silently fail on unloaded fonts or images.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on building a html to PDF api (https://pagedpdf.com) to fix common issues with generating pdfs.
